title: 有 Demo，不代表有人要
series: The Founder's Playbook - Building an AI-Native Startup
audience: Founders, solo builders, AI startup operators, and technical product leaders

coverGrid.note: Cover crop constraints apply later; this scene graph is for video timing.

visualSystem.lockedStyleName: Founder Playbook Abstract Concept Symbol Gate
visualSystem.styleIntent: reuse Founder Playbook warm decision-gate family while changing the central artifact to prototype/evidence logic
typography: Rounded / humanist Chinese sans stack from the confirmed Founder Playbook cover system
Avenir Next / Inter / system sans for UI metadata
palette: rose for false proof or weak validation
layoutGrammar: Keep the stable Founder Playbook top metadata and bottom integrated subtitle.
Use one dominant central artifact per voice chunk.
Do not force PDF screenshots into the frame; source value is carried by structured gates and labels.
Choose the diagram shape from the spoken idea: path for fast build, split panel for false validation, vertical checks for validation, stack for evidence questions, threshold for signal quality.
Do not use equal-column diagram symmetry unless the content has equal peer concepts.

layoutRegions.bottom: burned-in subtitle text without a box

artifactTreatment: Treat Demo as a visible object that can move between proof, question tool, praise, and evidence states.
Represent problem-solution fit as three checks: real/frequent problem, actual solution fit, enough signal for MVP.
Represent customer discovery as question cards and evidence chips, not as long interview script text.
Do not imply source publisher endorsement.
Do not use PMF metrics in this episode.
symbolGrammar: Comply with the locked Founder Playbook VI: warm black field, cream text, amber/cyan/rose semantic tones, rounded 8px geometry, and restrained glow.
Fit symbols to content and concept: path for fast build, void for empty evidence, bars for signal strength, crossing paths for mismatch, nodes/path for question vector, frame for boundary.
Keep symbols easy to understand at phone size; use short labels only as anchors.
Use common visual grammar before invention: paths, gates, thresholds, bars, nodes, dashed empty states, and boundaries.
Keep abstract style; avoid literal product UI, person, mascot, or decorative object icons.
motionPrinciples: One visual focus per voice chunk.
Motion is semantic: reveal, shift from proof to question tool, gate check activation, weak-question dimming, evidence-chip highlight.
Dynamic focus should land on or just before the spoken focus phrase.
Keep subtitles clear of validation checks and final decision cards.
Animation order, speed, and hold time follow the measured voice timing instead of a reusable preset effect.
frameFittingConstraints: Subtitles must not sit in a box or collide with central artifacts.
No frame may rely on dense interview text for meaning.
Every diagram must remain readable as a phone-feed frame: short labels, content-fitted spacing, no tiny corrective notes.

soundEffects.rationale: Major opening action: the idea becomes a Demo surface. A short rise supports speed without treating every motion as an event.
Major concept notification: Demo praise is not evidence. The dim sound marks absence, not failure drama.
Major decision movement: evidence becomes strong enough to open the next gate.
Major contrast beat: polite praise is filtered out as weak validation.

soundEffects.concept: Demo locks as question tool, not proof
soundEffects.rationale: Major final decision: the episode's mental model resolves into the question-tool frame.
Major bridge action only: the next boundary gate appears without turning the ending into a sequence of notifications.

sourceRefs.role: source value inventory and page-area mapping
episode scope and retained source value

sourceFidelityGuardrails: Do not imply demos are useless; the source says prototypes are useful pressure-testing props.
Keep this episode inside the Idea-stage gate; do not teach MVP / PMF mechanics.
Do not use unverified source metrics such as the 42% startup failure claim.
Do not turn Claude-specific product advice into universal startup doctrine.
Problem-solution fit is the Idea-stage exit condition.
sourceValueRetained: Problem-solution fit requires real, specific problem evidence and solution fit.
Customer conversations and disconfirming evidence are the real evidence.
The bridge points to MVP boundary discipline without teaching Episode 3.

scenes.claim: AI 让 Demo 很快出现
scenes.narration: AI 让你很快做出 Demo。
scenes.subtitle: AI 很快做出 Demo。
scenes.focusCue: convert idea card into Demo card
scenes.motion: idea card flashes through AI lane and becomes a Demo surface

scenes.claim: Demo 出现容易制造已经验证的错觉
scenes.narration: 但最危险的地方也在这里：演示版一出来，你很容易以为问题已经被验证了。
scenes.subtitle: Demo 一出来，很容易以为问题已验证。
scenes.focusCue: show proof stamp failing while evidence panel stays empty
scenes.motion: Demo receives a weak proof stamp; evidence panel remains blank

scenes.narration: 其实，Demo 不是没用。它很有用。
scenes.subtitle: Demo 不是没用，它很有用。
scenes.focusCue: keep Demo card active instead of crossing it out
scenes.motion: a failed cross-out dissolves and the Demo card remains active

scenes.claim: Demo 的用处是问清楚问题，而不是证明创始人正确
scenes.narration: 但它不是用来证明你对了，而是用来帮你问清楚：这个问题到底是不是真的存在。
scenes.subtitle: 它不是证明你对了，而是帮你问清楚。
scenes.focusCue: move Demo from proof lane to question lane
scenes.motion: Demo card leaves the proof lane and docks beside question cards

scenes.claim: 想法阶段要过的是验证关，不是能不能做出来
scenes.narration: 在想法阶段，真正要过的不是“能不能做出来”，而是三件事。
scenes.subtitle: 想法阶段，真正要过的是三件事。
scenes.focusCue: replace build question with three validation checks
scenes.motion: build question dims; three validation checks appear

scenes.claim: 问题必须真实、具体、经常发生
scenes.narration: 第一，问题是不是真实、具体，而且经常发生。
scenes.subtitle: 问题是否真实、具体、经常发生。
scenes.motion: three problem-quality chips reveal and lock

scenes.claim: 方案必须解决用户真正的问题
scenes.narration: 第二，你的方案是不是解决了用户真正的问题，而不是你一开始想象的问题。
scenes.subtitle: 方案是否解决了真正的问题。
scenes.focusCue: move solution from assumed problem to actual user problem
scenes.motion: solution line disconnects from assumed problem and reconnects to user problem

scenes.claim: 进入 MVP 需要足够信号，而不是确定性
scenes.narration: 第三，信号够不够支持你开始做 MVP。
scenes.subtitle: 信号是否足够支持开始做 MVP。
scenes.motion: evidence meter fills just enough to unlock MVP gate

scenes.claim: 不要只问未来式的礼貌问题
scenes.narration: 所以，别只问用户：“你会不会用？”
scenes.subtitle: 别只问：“你会不会用？”
scenes.motion: future-facing question fades into weak signal

scenes.claim: 更好的问题追问过去行为和现有替代方案
scenes.narration: 更好的问题是：你上一次遇到这个问题是什么时候？现在怎么解决？为什么还不换？
scenes.subtitle: 上次什么时候遇到？现在怎么解决？为什么还不换？

artifact.highlight: 上一次 / 现在 / 为什么

scenes.focusPhrase: 上一次 / 现在 / 为什么
scenes.motion: three question cards stack into an evidence column

scenes.claim: 只夸 Demo 还不是答案
scenes.narration: 如果用户只是在夸 Demo，你还没有答案。
scenes.subtitle: 只是在夸 Demo，还没有答案。
scenes.focusCue: dim praise lane and keep answer locked
scenes.motion: praise chip glows briefly, then fades below evidence threshold

scenes.claim: 真实痛点和反证比赞美更有价值
scenes.narration: 如果他开始暴露真实痛点，甚至指出你的 Demo 哪里没解决问题，那才是更有价值的信号。
scenes.subtitle: 暴露真实痛点，才是更有价值的信号。
scenes.motion: pain and contradiction chips rise above praise into evidence lane

scenes.claim: Demo 能提问，不能证明有人要
scenes.narration: 这一集的判断是：Demo 可以帮你问问题，但不能替你证明有人要。
scenes.subtitle: Demo 可以帮你问问题，不能证明有人要。
scenes.focusCue: split final decision into question tool versus proof
scenes.motion: final decision card locks question tool and blocks proof claim

scenes.claim: 下一关是确定要做以后先定边界
scenes.narration: 下一集，我们看确定要做以后，为什么要先定边界，再让 AI 写。
scenes.subtitle: 下一集：先定边界，再让 AI 写。
scenes.motion: Demo/evidence gate clears and the boundary gate appears as next episode preview
